info.name: Crypto Payment SDK - Payment Service
info.description: Manual-test collection for the single-network Ethereum Payment Service. Read docs/PAYMENT_SERVICE_POSTMAN.md before running requests and follow its safety gates. Collection variables for credentials are intentionally blank.

item.name: 00 - Health and status
item.description: Safe preflight requests. Run these before mutations.

request.description: Expected HTTP 200 with {"status":"live"}. Liveness alone does not prove dependencies are ready.
Expected HTTP 200 with ready. HTTP 503 means PS is reachable but a dependency or projection is not ready.
Loopback-only metrics listener. Expected HTTP 200 and Prometheus text.

exec: pm.test('Metrics body is not empty', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text().length).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Sanitized dependency, cursor, policy, backlog, and readiness status. Requires administrator credentials.

exec: pm.test('Status identifies the configured Payment Service scope', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.service).to.eql('payment-service'); pm.expect(body.scope.chain).to.eql('ethereum'); pm.expect(body.scope.network).to.eql(pm.variables.get('network')); pm.expect(String(body.scope.chain_id)).to.eql(pm.variables.get('chain_id')); });

pm.test('PS and dependencies report ready', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.ready).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.indexer_ready).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.wallet_ready).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 01 - Deposits
item.description: Ordinary exchange operations. Create Deposit is safe only against an approved disposable/local environment. Close Deposit is high impact and its pre-request gate skips transmission unless explicitly enabled.

request.description: Creates or exactly replays a durable create-deposit job. Change run_id before a genuinely new semantic command. Keep it unchanged only for an exact replay.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id') { console.warn('Skipped: set a unique run_id before creating durable state'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
var valid = pm.response.code === 202 && typeof body.job_id === 'string' && body.job_id.length > 0 && typeof body.deposit_id === 'string' && body.deposit_id.length > 0;
pm.test('Response contains durable IDs', function () { pm.expect(valid).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Exact replay keeps the original IDs', function () { pm.expect(body.job_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('create_deposit_job_id')); pm.expect(body.deposit_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('create_deposit_id')); });

request.description: Lists deposits. Valid state values: awaiting_watch, active, expired, closed. Enable cursor only when continuing a page.

exec: pm.test('Paginated response shape', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.deposits).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('next_cursor'); });

request.description: Returns one deposit. Address and birthday must remain absent while state is awaiting_watch.

exec: pm.test('Address disclosure follows watch state', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); if (body.state === 'awaiting_watch') { pm.expect(body.address).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.birthday).to.eql(null); } if (body.state === 'active') { pm.expect(body.address).to.match(/^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$/); pm.expect(body.birthday).to.match(/^[0-9]+$/); } });

request.description: Returns absolute atomic-unit balances: received, confirmed, balance, collected, and accounted.

exec: pm.test('All balances are decimal strings', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); ['received','confirmed','balance','collected','accounted'].forEach(function (key) { pm.expect(body[key]).to.match(/^[0-9]+$/); }); });

if (pm.variables.get('expect_unfunded') === 'true') { pm.test('Unfunded smoke deposit has zero balances', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); ['received','confirmed','balance','collected','accounted'].forEach(function (key) { pm.expect(body[key]).to.eql('0'); }); }); }

item.name: Get ledger and capture current head

request.description: Reads one ledger page and derives the unreferenced entry as ledger_head_id. Follow all pages before trusting this derivation when next_cursor is non-null.

exec: if (pm.variables.get('expect_unfunded') === 'true') { pm.test('Unfunded ledger contains its opened zero snapshot', function () { var opened = body.entries.find(function (entry) { return entry.cause && entry.cause.kind === 'opened'; }); pm.expect(opened, 'opened ledger entry').to.exist; ['received','confirmed','balance','collected','accounted'].forEach(function (key) { pm.expect(opened.balances[key]).to.eql('0'); }); }); }

if (head && pm.variables.get('expect_unfunded') === 'true') { pm.test('Unfunded smoke ledger head is the zero snapshot', function () { ['received','confirmed','balance','collected','accounted'].forEach(function (key) { pm.expect(head.balances[key]).to.eql('0'); }); }); }

request.description: Returns IX facts associated with this deposit. Observation cursor is an unsigned decimal event cursor.

exec: pm.test('Observation page shape', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.observations).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('next_cursor'); });
if (pm.variables.get('expect_unfunded') === 'true') { pm.test('Unfunded smoke deposit has no observations', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().observations).to.be.an('array').and.empty; }); }

request.description: DANGEROUS/PRECONDITIONED: the queued close job succeeds only at an exact zero-balance ledger head with no active reservation or open reconciliation. Do not include this request in an automatic smoke run.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id' || pm.variables.get('allow_high_impact') !== 'true' || pm.variables.get('approved_action') !== 'close_deposit' || !pm.variables.get('approved_deposit_id')) { console.warn('Skipped: unique run_id, approved_action=close_deposit, high-impact approval, and approved_deposit_id are required'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

item.name: 02 - Jobs
item.description: Poll existing durable jobs; do not create replacement commands because a dependency temporarily timed out.

request.description: Poll until succeeded or failed. waiting_retry retains the same job ID and should be polled rather than recreated.

item.name: 03 - Collections
item.description: Collection reads plus gated writes. Create and Retry are skipped unless high-impact approval and explicit approved IDs are set; they can ultimately sign and broadcast a transaction.

request.description: DANGEROUS: creates a durable collection workflow that can sign and broadcast. Requires an eligible spendable balance and explicit authorization.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id' || pm.variables.get('allow_high_impact') !== 'true' || pm.variables.get('approved_action') !== 'create_collection' || !pm.variables.get('approved_deposit_id')) { console.warn('Skipped: unique run_id, approved_action=create_collection, high-impact approval, and approved_deposit_id are required'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('HTTP 202 when collection is accepted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });
var valid = pm.response.code === 202 && typeof body.job_id === 'string' && body.job_id.length > 0 && typeof body.collection_id === 'string' && body.collection_id.length > 0;
pm.test('Response contains durable IDs', function () { pm.expect(valid).to.eql(true); });

request.description: deposit_id is required. Enable cursor only to continue a page.

exec: pm.test('Collection page shape', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.collections).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('next_cursor'); });

request.description: Returns collection reservation and leg lifecycle details.
DANGEROUS/PRECONDITIONED: use only for a retryable failed or reorged collection. Can lead to signing and broadcasting.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id' || pm.variables.get('allow_high_impact') !== 'true' || pm.variables.get('approved_action') !== 'retry_collection' || !pm.variables.get('approved_collection_id')) { console.warn('Skipped: unique run_id, approved_action=retry_collection, high-impact approval, and approved_collection_id are required'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('HTTP 202 when retry is accepted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });

item.name: 04 - Administrator operations
item.description: Administrator-only reconciliation reads plus gated business mutations. Accounting and resolution requests are skipped unless high-impact approval and explicit approved values are set.

request.description: DANGEROUS BUSINESS MUTATION: next_accounted is an absolute amount, not a delta. Requires the complete current ledger head and a confirmation-qualified business decision.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id' || pm.variables.get('allow_high_impact') !== 'true' || pm.variables.get('approved_action') !== 'account_deposit' || !pm.variables.get('approved_deposit_id') || !pm.variables.get('approved_ledger_head_id') || !pm.variables.get('approved_next_accounted')) { console.warn('Skipped: unique run_id, approved_action=account_deposit, high-impact approval, and approved accounting values are required'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('HTTP 200 when accounting is applied or replayed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var valid = pm.response.code === 200 && body.deposit_id === pm.variables.get('approved_deposit_id') && body.ledger_entry && typeof body.ledger_entry.ledger_entry_id === 'string';
pm.test('Returns immutable ledger entry for approved deposit', function () { pm.expect(valid).to.eql(true); });

request.description: state may be open or all. deposit_id and cursor are optional.
Returns one reconciliation case. Requires administrator credentials.
DANGEROUS BUSINESS MUTATION: reverses credited accounting at the optimistic ledger head. Do not include external_reference.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id' || pm.variables.get('allow_high_impact') !== 'true' || pm.variables.get('approved_action') !== 'resolve_reverse_credit' || !pm.variables.get('approved_case_id') || !pm.variables.get('approved_ledger_head_id')) { console.warn('Skipped: unique run_id, approved_action=resolve_reverse_credit, high-impact approval, and approved reconciliation values are required'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('HTTP 200 when resolution is valid', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: DANGEROUS BUSINESS MUTATION: accepts liability. Body accepts only resolution and reason. Use a new run_id if this is the chosen semantic command.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id' || pm.variables.get('allow_high_impact') !== 'true' || pm.variables.get('approved_action') !== 'resolve_accept_liability' || !pm.variables.get('approved_case_id')) { console.warn('Skipped: unique run_id, approved_action=resolve_accept_liability, high-impact approval, and approved_case_id are required'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('HTTP 200 when resolution is valid', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: DANGEROUS BUSINESS MUTATION: records an external debt reference. Do not include expected_ledger_head.

exec: if (!runId || runId === 'replace-with-unique-run-id' || pm.variables.get('allow_high_impact') !== 'true' || pm.variables.get('approved_action') !== 'resolve_external_debt' || !pm.variables.get('approved_case_id') || !pm.variables.get('approved_external_reference')) { console.warn('Skipped: unique run_id, approved_action=resolve_external_debt, high-impact approval, and approved external-debt values are required'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
pm.test('HTTP 200 when resolution is valid', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
